newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Fernz plans takeover of France's CFPI.
newsitem.headline: Fernz plans takeover of France's CFPI.

text.p: New Zealand fertiliser and chemicals company Fernz Corporation Ltd said on Friday it had bought the founding familiy's shares in French company CFPI, and now holds 45.14 percent of CFPI's equity.
The stake cost Fernz NZ$53 million.

Fernz said that in accordance with French regulatory requirements it now intended to lodge a draft takeover document and bid for the remaining shares in CFPI, with a starting indicative price of 380 francs per share.
The successful acquisition of the remaining shares at that price would take the total acquisition cost to NZ$129 million.
CFPI has forecast a tax-paid profit in its June 1997 financial year of around NZ$10 million.
"Fernz is confident that a successful acquisition at this price will be value-creating for its shareholders," Fernz said.
